question: Within a 150 kilometers range, where can I find a restaurant on the way to Bowditch Middle School Auditorium, Foster City, CA from Sense Fine Art, Menlo Park, CA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sense Fine Art%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Menlo Park%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Bowditch Middle School Auditorium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Foster City%' LIMIT 1 ), route_corridor AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM start_point), (SELECT geometry FROM end_point) )::geography, 150000 -- 150 kilometers in meters ) AS corridor_geometry ) SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois, route_corridor WHERE amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects(pois.geometry::geography, route_corridor.corridor_geometry);
